carried.name: Desk Terminal, Joined
carried.summary: Round 13: #1 by score (mean 8.33, in 7 judges' top fours); carried as the best score of the round (clearly different here means 5.9 or more apart; the round's median is 9.83). Family: docked terminal column. Born in round 13 (informed). Desk Terminal made whole: every page opens on one head row, the terminal beside the desk fits, sticks or folds to a line, Home's question is its headline typed at the foot of the glass with the box as the tube's last rows, and the light reaches the desk and Status as data. One real terminal still stands at the left of the family's desk, the only cased, rounded, lit thing on the page, but now it joins the page instead of crowding it. On Home it reads like a real terminal: scrollback at the top of the glass (her screen, the day, Next up in inverse, the radar), her question at its foot as the page's 40px headline, and the box to answer in as the tube's last rows, over a graphite keyboard ledge. Everywhere else a head row names the page first, and the terminal fits the screen and sticks, or folds to one lit line where nothing is live. The phosphor now carries data on the desk too: a white-hot NOW lamp with a lit stretch of rail, a steady lit NOW tick in To do, and a moving-coil spend meter on Status. The feel is a calm, grounded desk with one live machine on it.

carried.name: Backlit Plate
carried.summary: Round 13: #3 by score (mean 7.8, in 5 judges' top fours); carried as new family, not a near-duplicate: long-persistence instrument; nearest carried Desk Terminal, Joined at 8.97. Family: long-persistence instrument. Born in round 13 (informed). One live phosphor screen lies behind the whole page and a matte slate plate is laid over it: light shows only where the plate is cut, and the plate is cut only where the machine is live. The page is a backlit faceplate: one continuous, square, matte slate plate is laid over a live phosphor screen and centred on the black room. Every light the original tube gave off is still there at full strength, but each has a physical cause. "mind" is stencilled through the plate, Send is a backlit key whose light pools out of its gap, a field's cut edge lights while you type, every lamp is a pinhole, and the screens are windows whose light falls on their bevels and spills onto the plate. The shape of a cut says what it shows: a slot is time, a round window is place, a square window is Vera, and a 4:3 window is the screen proper. Where nothing is live the plate stays whole, so the page feels calm and material, and the green appears only where attention belongs.

carried.name: Quote Board at Evening
carried.summary: Round 13: #5 by score (mean 7.76, in 5 judges' top fours); carried as new family, not a near-duplicate: count board; nearest carried Backlit Plate at 8.6. Family: count board. Born in round 13 (crossover). Single Quote's trading terminal, one thing set large on every screen, lit and laid in Evening Listing's slate, steel and bone. A calm evening trading desk. Every page opens on one quote: a condensed Archivo title, its figure in the section colour, and a stacked unit and change line. Everything under it is a register read along a line to fixed columns of facts. One slate rail of numbered keys frames the page. Traced's materials each have one job: green-black glass for what the machine shows, slate for what the family owns and presses, steel reverse video for "here", denim for a link, bone ink for words, and amber only as a caution. The #6dff9c phosphor lights only the live things (the mark and its cursor, the lit number of the key you are on, "mind", Send, the lamps, the now lamp and the tubes), and it lights them at full bloom.

carried.name: Evening Listing, Traced
carried.summary: Round 13: #6 by score (mean 7.62, in 1 judges' top fours); carried as new family, not a near-duplicate: programme listing; nearest carried Backlit Plate at 8.07. Family: programme listing. Round 12: #2 by score (mean 8.09, in 7 judges' top fours); carried as new family, not a near-duplicate: programme listing; nearest carried Desk Terminal at 9.17. Family: programme listing. Born in round 12 (informed). Evening Listing, Relit with its light put to work: the tube traces the coming weeks, the rails are lit from now, and every band head says one figure. This refines Evening Listing, Relit. The programme listing on slate stays whole, and the phosphor light now draws data instead of only glowing. Next up's spare glass becomes a four-week trace of the plans. Coming up, To do and Status's Who answers each carry a rail that is lit from now, or between live lamps. A row you point at lights and fades like phosphor. The page stays calm and grounded, with the light where the family's time is.

wildCarried.name: Dessau Phosphor
wildCarried.summary: Round 13: #12 by score (mean 6.47, in 1 judges' top fours); carried as the wild lane, for the ideas the judges most want developed (4 promise votes, #12 by score, today 4.72): bauhaus display type. Family: bauhaus display type. Born in round 13 (wild). Every page a poster: its name set large and lowercase beside a square of its ink, its one live figure glowing on a round green screen, and four shapes with four jobs (the circle is light, the square the family's, the bar the page's, the triangle what needs a look). The family's page set as Bauhaus posters, lit by one green tube. Every page opens with its name in lowercase Outfit beside a solid square of the section's print ink, and the page's one live figure glows on a round phosphor screen. Everything else is matte: square slate cards, bone type, dimmed inks, thick bars. The page should feel bold, calm and printed, with the full original phosphor light (bloom, blur, scanlines, sweep, afterglow) only where the machine speaks.

wildCarried.name: Folio Switchboard
wildCarried.summary: Round 13: #9 by score (mean 6.88, in 2 judges' top fours); carried as the wild lane, for the ideas the judges most want developed (2 promise votes, #9 by score, today 4.72): videotex service. Family: videotex service. Born in round 13 (wild mutant). The videotex switchboard typeset as its own contents page: titles and heads in Fraunces, and the pictures are the family's own facts printed large, on five steps and in two inks (a count at the end of each leader, how far an idea is by road, the day a thing is due, the days of the month, each person's initial, and each page's folio, the largest and the quietest), while only the machine gives off light. The parent's switchboard is kept whole: a rack of equal cells, a sommaire Home, numbered pages, and a green tube under every plate. It is typeset as the contents page it always was. Titles and cell heads are in Fraunces, and the page's pictures are the family's own facts printed large: drive times, due days, days of the month, counts, initials. It should feel like an almanac printed on a graphite panel. Everything the family keeps is matte ink at one value. Only the machine gives off phosphor light: the tubes, the radar, her screen, the mark, SEND, the lamps and focus.

changes: set the family's text in a serif from the library (Source Serif 4, Literata, Newsreader or IBM Plex Serif), with a sans or mono for labels and controls
headings trimmed to their caps (text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic), so titles sit exactly on the rule or edge above
leading tuned per size: about 1.1 for titles, 1.5-1.6 for body, 1.3 for labels
the monitors redrawn as illustrations: a detailed period terminal or scope, drawn in SVG, around the green glass
a drawn divider or ornament between sections (a rule with a small mark, a bracket, a leader)
the section heads on Home (Coming up, To do, the kids' wishes) and the setup steps given a small line drawing each
the structure of Folio Switchboard (its markup, layout, type, controls, spacing and non-colour css) with the colours of Evening Listing, Traced (its tokens, glow numbers and colour roles)
bring back the original Phosphor page's light wherever this design shows phosphor: every effect in phosphor_kit.md that fits it, in this design's own terms
glowing dots on the black: the live lamps and status lights as small green points that glow and breathe, and a faint field of phosphor dots where the machine speaks
the primary actions lit from within: a green ring and light pooled under the primary button and Send
